subject: Azure tenant crosswalk & field assimilation plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@microsoft.com>, Julie Green <julie.green@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Azure tenant crosswalk & field assimilation plan

Hi Aisha / Julie —

Following our call last week, I put together a lightweight plan to get Partner Center referrals and Contoso field sellers aligned on account ownership for the initial Marketplace listings. Goal: produce a clean tenant/account crosswalk and a seller ownership matrix that Partner Center will accept for referral routing.

Attachments: tenant-crosswalk-template.csv (template for tenant IDs / subscription mapping), seller-ownership-matrix.xlsx (suggested fields for owner, region, seller ID).

High level ask from Contoso / Microsoft:
- Confirm the authoritative account identifier you want in the crosswalk (Tenant ID, Subscription ID, Partner Center account ID).
- Share a priority list of 50 accounts we should map first (customer-facing sellers + recommended sellers).
- Confirm whether Contoso wants to route referrals to field sellers (preferred) or to centralized marketplace ops for now.

Proposed timeline (1 week workback):
1) Today — Karthik shares templates (attached)
2) By 9/3 — Microsoft / Contoso return a sample export / mapping for 10 accounts
3) 9/6 — Redwood validates IDs and provides a reconciliation report
4) 9/8 — Finalize mapping; handoff to Partner Center for referral routing tests

Can you confirm the identifier (Tenant ID vs Partner Center ID) and whether the seller mapping lives in Partner Center or within Contoso CRM? If you prefer, we can kick off a 30-minute working session later this week.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132

Redwood Inference — production-first inference for LLMs

Attachments: tenant-crosswalk-template.csv (CSV), seller-ownership-matrix.xlsx (Excel)

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@microsoft.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Julie Green <julie.green@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure tenant crosswalk & field assimilation plan

Thanks Karthik — this looks good. Quick answers:
- Partner Center prefers Partner Center Account ID for referral routing (we can accept a crosswalk that includes Tenant ID + Partner Center ID).
- I'll have our PC operations export this week; I'll include the pc_account_id column.
- For Contoso sellers, they typically route referrals to local field sellers unless an account is marked as centralized. For the pilot, let's route to field sellers.

I attached a small sample export (PC-referrals-export.csv) with the columns we'll send; it should map cleanly to your template. A couple of notes from PC ops: make sure the owner email matches the Partner Center seller record and include a territory code column if you can.

We can do a 30-minute working session tomorrow 9/2 at 11am PT to walk through the sample. Vanessa / Ben — can you join and share any mapping rules you require on the Redwood side?

Best,
Aisha Patel
Partner Channel Manager, Microsoft Azure
aisha.patel@microsoft.com

Attachment: PC-referrals-export.csv

- Added pc_account_id and territory_code columns to the tenant-crosswalk-template.csv
- Owner identifier accepts either partner center seller ID or owner email; we will validate both during reconciliation

Action items after today's working session (9/2 11am PT):
- Contoso: provide PC export for first 10 accounts (including pc_account_id, tenant_id, owner_email, territory_code) — Julie
- Microsoft PC ops: confirm mapping rules for suspended/inactive seller records — Aisha
- Redwood: run a validation pass and provide reconciliation (format issues, duplicate tenants, orphaned PC IDs) by 9/6 — Neha + Ben

Proposed meeting invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meetings/karthik/az-pc-crosswalk (I added provisional 9/2 11:00 PT).

If that looks good I'll proceed to kick off the reconciliation run once we receive the sample export.

-Karthik
